items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I remember when I hired... Davey Tough... he said, 'Is that the guy that used to be with Tommy Dorsey?' And I said, 'Yeah.'

ctx.x: Oh, Davie Tufts set the pattern there, I think. In fact, I'm sure he did. I remember when I hired Well, Davey Tough Davie, Chubby was still new in the band, and he said, "Is that the guy that used to be with Tommy Dorsey?" And I said, "Yeah." He said, "Do you think he'll fit the band?" I said, "Oh, yeah," I said, "Yeah, he'll fit the band."
Well, anyway, two days later, after Davey got there, Chubby had decided he invented Davey. Davey.
